LanguageData.RK_Backstory_RefugeeSlave.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a slave who barely managed to escape. [PAWN_pronoun] survived by enduring years of grueling labor.
LanguageData.RK_Backstory_RefugeeSlave.title: Ratkin refugee slave
LanguageData.RK_Unique_Kira_Adulthood.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a legendary warrior known as the Grey Claw. [PAWN_pronoun] earned that name by repelling countless raids alone, inspiring both fear and respect among [PAWN_possessive] kin.
LanguageData.RK_Unique_Kira_Adulthood.title: grey claw
LanguageData.RK_Unique_Kira_Childhood.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was the only orphan to survive a tunnel collapse. Alone in the darkness, [PAWN_pronoun] learned to find a way and developed an instinctive sense for danger.
LanguageData.RK_Unique_Kira_Childhood.title: orphan of the grey tunnels
